Title: THE GREATEST MUSICAL ARTIST
Detail_lesson: Technical skill, cultural reach, invention, staying power — no single measure settles it, which is the point.
CustomInstruction: Name one artist and defend them in one sentence. Say which yardstick you are using — influence, craft, or what the music did to you — because the room will argue about the yardstick, not the name.

Title: THE MOST INFLUENTIAL FILM EVER MADE
Detail_lesson: Influence is not the same as quality or box office. Some films changed how movies are made; others changed what audiences would accept.
CustomInstruction: Pick one film and say what changed *because of it* — a technique, a genre, an argument. If you cannot name the thing that changed, pick a different film.

Title: THE GREATEST WORK OF ART IN HISTORY
Detail_lesson: Painting, sculpture, building, photograph — any medium counts. Technical mastery and cultural weight often point at different works.
CustomInstruction: Name the work and the room it lives in if you know it. Then finish this sentence: without this piece, art would be missing ______.

Title: THE MOST INFLUENTIAL PERSON IN HISTORY
Detail_lesson: Influence cuts both ways — some of the most consequential lives were not admirable ones.
CustomInstruction: Name one person and the specific change that traces back to them. Judge by consequence, not by whether you would want dinner with them.

Title: THE ONE PLACE EVERYONE SHOULD SEE
Detail_lesson: Some places earn it through beauty, some through history, some because they rearrange how you think.
CustomInstruction: Name the place and the single moment there that justifies the trip — a view, a meal, a walk. Vague endorsements lose to specific ones.

Title: THE GREATEST COMFORT FOOD
Detail_lesson: Comfort food is rarely the best food. It is the food that does a job.
CustomInstruction: Name the dish and the situation it repairs. Bonus if it is yours rather than a national favourite.

Title: THE GREATEST ATHLETE OF ALL TIME
Detail_lesson: Dominance within a sport, or impact beyond it? Longevity, or peak? The criteria decide the winner before the names do.
CustomInstruction: State your criterion first, then your athlete. One sentence each. Cross-sport comparisons are allowed and encouraged.

Title: THE MOST IMPORTANT BOOK EVER WRITTEN
Detail_lesson: Important is doing a lot of work here: scripture, science, novels and manifestos have all reshaped how people live.
CustomInstruction: Name the book and who it changed — a field, a country, a movement. Personal favourites are fine only if you can show the ripple.

Title: THE GREATEST INVENTION IN HUMAN HISTORY
Detail_lesson: The candidates range from the plough to the transistor. The strongest cases are usually for inventions that made other inventions possible.
CustomInstruction: Name one invention and what became possible only after it. Resist naming the most recent thing you used.

Title: THE BEST AGE TO BE
Detail_lesson: Each decade trades something away for something else: energy for judgement, freedom for capability, certainty for perspective.
CustomInstruction: Name an age or decade and the trade it wins. Answer for a life in general, not just for yours — then tell us if your own answer differs.
